rv.q: I thought it was a wonderful experience and, even though the two productions could not be more different in style and ambition, I felt much the same about my trip to Howard Street the other night, seated at the bar (my favorite seat here), chatting with theatergoers, talking, hearing and loving Sondheim.
This original new musical revue is as exquisite, entertaining and exciting an evening as anyone could ever desire.
Although some of the higher-level creative choices don’t quite cohere, the evening is a showcase for a strong cast and provides them space to honor one of America’s most important artists.
This Sondheim Tribute Revue is going to be over the top.
This is one that you should put on your "TO DO LIST" and then do it!
Sondheim Tribute Revue is a good, solid show–a Sondheim sampler if you will: more than 30 songs from 15 musicals performed by a talented and enthusiastic five-member ensemble.

cn.t: Critics praise this delightful Sondheim tribute for its mellifluous performances and thoughtful song selection, with Theo Ubique doing justice to the master's legacy in an intimate cabaret setting that honors his artistic sophistication.
